description: Ramanujan's series (manuscript eq. (1)) sums to 1/pi (orientation anchor)
J(s) = int_0^1 [a(1-a)]^s da = B(s+1,s+1) = Gamma(s+1)^2/Gamma(2s+2) (quadrature audit over 8 values of s)
J(s) J(1-s) = pi s(1-s) cot(pi s) / (2 (2s+1)(1-2s)(3-2s)) (8-point numerical sweep)
Apparent poles of the right-hand side at s = -1/2, 1/2, 3/2 are removable (cot(pi s) vanishes there); the limits agree with J(s)J(1-s)
K(1/sqrt(2)) = Gamma(1/4)^2 / (4 sqrt(pi)) (classical lemniscatic evaluation)
J(3/4) = 3 pi / (20 K(1/sqrt(2))), i.e. the conjugate stratum is proportional to the reciprocal period
(1/pi) int_0^1 x^n / sqrt(x(1-x)) dx = 4^(-n) C(2n,n) (quadrature audit for n = 0..4)
(4n)!/(n!)^4 = C(4n,2n) C(2n,n)^2, exactly (n = 0..30 audited)
A_n = 256^n m_(2n) m_n^2 with m_k the arcsine moments of R5.1 (restatement of R5.1 + R5.2; not a generating mechanism)
A_s(alpha) / I_s(alpha) = alpha / (s+1) (quadrature audit at 4 points)
d/d(alpha) log I_s(alpha) = psi(s+alpha+1) - psi(s-alpha+1) (numerical differentiation at 4 points)
G_beta(z) = sum J(n) z^n = 2F1(1, 1; 3/2; z/4), checked at z = 1
G_arc(z)^2 = (1-z)^(-1) = 1F0(1; ; z): a degenerate square with no Gauss-type 2F1 square-root structure
psi(3/4) - psi(1/4) = pi (Gauss digamma theorem / reflection)
psi(3/2) - psi(1) = 2 - 2 log 2 (diagonal s = alpha = 1/4)
psi'(1/4) = pi^2 + 8 G (Catalan's constant enters at second order)
Trigamma reflection psi'(1/4) + psi'(3/4) = 2 pi^2, and psi'(1/4) - psi'(3/4) = 16 G; together these give R8.3
psi'(1/4) - psi'(3/4) = 16 G (Dirichlet beta at 2)
Second-order response d^2/d(alpha)^2 log I_s(alpha) = psi'(s+alpha+1) + psi'(s-alpha+1), realised at (s, alpha) = (-1/2, -1/4) where it equals psi'(1/4) + psi'(3/4)
